steps.name: Epilogue ~ An Invitation
steps.objective: Watch the conversation between [Chloris] and [Zephyros] 「Outside Twilight Cathedral」 after the adventurer leaves.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Zephy, you have been through so much. And I had no idea. I... I...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, no more crying. There, there.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: ...Okay. No more crying.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Like this?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You need not look quite so stern.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: All right. Shall we go, then? Oh...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Wait a moment...
(Chloris raises her head toward the highest spire of the Twilight Cathedral.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, you sensed something, did you not?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Someone was up there. The witch is gone, so who...? Wait. I have felt that magic somewhere before. Could it be the Magic Bureau?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe. Shh.
(Zephyros warily scans their surroundings, and Chloris nods quietly.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh, right. Zephy...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What is it, Chloe?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I just remembered somewhere I need to go before returning to the academy. Would you come with me? No, never mind. I will go alone. Oh...
(Chloris gives a little start as Zephyros takes her hand.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Let us go together.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: O-okay... All right.
(Their conversation finished, Zephyros and Chloris head toward Crystal Moon Forest.)
(A moment later, a boy who has been hiding behind the cathedral spire steps out, ears pricked.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: That mage. It has been a while. So, is the witch finished?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I came all this way and still missed the witch. Ugh, how irritating... I had a feeling another witch would get there first.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Let us go, Licaria.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Huh? Licaria?
(No Name calls the magic golem Licaria, but there is no response.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: So close, and I never noticed. Who are you? Who has my Licaria...?
(No Name spots a man adjusting his glasses while holding Licaria in place.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Grand Duke...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It has been a long time, nameless boy. A pleasure to see this golem again too.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: How unexpected, Grand Duke. Coming all the way here.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Have you been well?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: You know the answer. You knew exactly how I was doing.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I am merely asking after you.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Fine, let us call it that. As you know, I have not been well.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: If I had not met that uncouth adventurer and the little brat in Orcarium... I would have claimed that power. And I would never have died and come back to life.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Nameless boy. What did you just say? Would you repeat that?
(Barbatos’s surprise breaks his hold on Licaria, and the golem returns to No Name’s side.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Did you not hear me? I died and came back to life. That is why I came to hunt a witch, but this was a wasted trip.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I see. So that is what happened.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hahaha. Hahaha. Hahahahaha.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What is it, Grand Duke?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You have seeped into this world so slowly that even I could not feel the shadow you cast over it.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And you saved this boy as well.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: So you were watching this place from the Black Moon after all...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Grand Duke, why are you talking to yourself? Who are you speaking to?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The one who needed you and drew you out from between life and death. Someone like me, yet different...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It is a place I would have had to visit someday, though this is rather early. I would have preferred to go after shedding this shell of demonhood.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Boy.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What, Grand Duke?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Your plans have already gone awry. Why not come with me?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: That person... What changes if I meet them?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Whoever one may be, one’s fate changes.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Perhaps there is something for you to do there. Let us go.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Do we have to go right now?
(Barbatos looks intrigued by No Name’s question.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Shall we settle it with a silver coin? Look. The side engraved with a demon’s horns is heads.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: If it lands heads, you will come with me...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: And tails?
(With a mocking smile, Barbatos tosses the coin into the air.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will take it as your refusal to visit ▒▒▒▒, where the light has vanished...
(A moment later, the gleaming silver coin drops into Barbatos’s hand.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And collect the debt you owe me, here and now, with your death.
